page_title: LIV 2-1 WOL | Liverpool v Wolves 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Pedro Lima (Wolves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simon Hooper who sees an offensive foul.
90+5' It looks like Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+3' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nelson Semedo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pedro Lima (Wolves).
90+2' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. A free kick to Wolves.
90+2' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
89' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
88' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
87' 3:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

85' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a throw-in.
83' It will be a substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as Joao Gomes walks off.
82' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece.
82' The game is interrupted as Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is flagged offside.
80' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
79' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
77' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
76' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
73' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
71' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
71' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luis Diaz.
70' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Wolves have a corner.
69' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Liverpool was in an offside position.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde slips it to Matheus Cunha (Wolves) on the edge of the box and he finds the left side of the net with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
67' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Trent Alexander-Arnold and he is replaced by Conor Bradley (Liverpool).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) for Diogo Jota.

63' A clever short pass gives Joao Gomes (Wolves) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
61' Problems for Vitor Pereira as Emmanuel Agbadou is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Santiago Bueno (Wolves) replaces him.
60' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' The Liverpool players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Simon Hooper. NO PENALTY!
59' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Liverpool using VAR. Let's see what happens.
58' A player from Wolves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool are about to take a penalty!
57' Flag up against Andrew Robertson (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
54' Alisson (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has a goal ruled out for offside!
50' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range attempt straight to the middle of the goal.
50' A pass into the box finds Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alisson denies him.
49' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vitor Pereira probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Goncalo Guedes. He is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
46' Arne Slot makes a half-time substitution. Jarell Quansah comes on in place of Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
46' Vitor Pereira has made a change at the break. Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) has come on in place of Pablo Sarabia.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Simon Hooper blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Toti (Wolves) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
43' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
43' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Alisson comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) makes a strong challenge and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.

40' Close effort! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
39' A yellow card for a tackle by Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves). Simon Hooper doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
37' 2 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jose Sa into the roof of the net.
37' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is going to take the penalty!
37' Referee Simon Hooper is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Liverpool!
36' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Liverpool as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
35' Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul after Jose Sa (Wolves) hacks down one of his opponents. A penalty is awarded to Liverpool!
33' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
33' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

32' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Jose Sa leaps like a salmon to deny him. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) for a tough tackle.
30' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Referee Simon Hooper has finally had enough of Vitor Pereira and brandishes a yellow card at him!
27' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
26' The foul by Matt Doherty (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simon Hooper.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
25' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
23' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

22' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
21' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will take the corner.
21' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
20' The referee blows his whistle as Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
18' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.

17' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
15' 1 - 0 Luis Diaz (Liverpool) displays good awareness in the six-yard box and finds an unusual way to score by using his body to knock the ball behind the keeper. He makes it 1:0.
14' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is caught offside!
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
12' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to release Mohamed Salah with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
11' The corner kick from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
9' A lofted cross from Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
8' A rebound spins to Diogo Jota (Liverpool) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
7' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
4' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

1' A clever short pass gives Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
1' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
